headline: Last session: Sensex surges 1,534 points and Nifty nears 22,997 led by IT stocks rally

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 19 October.

why: Sensex skyrocketed 1,534 points and Nifty ended at 22,997 in a strong market rally.
IT stocks led the gains on Dalal Street as bulls returned.
Indian Rupee strengthened, supporting domestic stock market sentiment.
Market capitalization of nine of top-10 most valued firms surged by ₹3.65 trillion.
whatHappening: FPI selling crossed ₹52,000 crore in October, but Nifty continues to show resilience against foreign outflows.
TCS shined as top-10 valued Indian companies saw massive market cap addition.
IT sector led the market rally into the weekend.
Market experts issued targets for top stock picks ahead of Monday's session.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices surged sharply with the Sensex jumping 1,534 points and Nifty closing near 23,000, backed by strong gains in IT stocks and a strengthening rupee. Despite FPI outflows surpassing ₹52,000 crore in October, domestic equities rallied with top-10 firms adding ₹3.65 trillion in market capitalization. TCS led the major gainers among top valued firms as markets remain closed today for the weekend.
